title: Nine Feet of Steel
subtitle: 障碍与屏障 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 障碍与屏障（灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：障碍与屏障（灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：barrier　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 barrier 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the council put up ① a barrier at the end of our road and my father said the road was finished and the street was beginning. The ② barrier, meaning the thing itself and not the argument, was nine feet of steel and was climbed within a week; a barrier, he said, is the only object that exists to be proved wrong.

Every ③ barrier in that town was put up on a Friday, and the ④ barrier by the school, meaning the one with the gap and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever used properly. A barrier, my grandmother said, is nine parts intention and one part maintenance; my father said the intention is the part they photograph.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ barrier was the whole of the language, meaning the difficulty and not the steel. The ⑥ barrier, meaning the thing between two people and not any of that, is the only wall that grows when you look at it; a barrier, she said, is either something you climb or the only distance that cannot be measured in feet. He said the distance is the expensive half.

By 1973 the ⑦ barrier had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about who had asked for it. The ⑧ barrier of the whole thing, my father wrote in May, was nine years of steel and one gap; a barrier, he said, is either the thing at the end of the road or the reason you learned to climb. She said the climbing was the part nobody counted.

The ⑨ barrier I remember is the one by the school, which was taken away in 1975 and never replaced. A ⑩ barrier, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only structure that improves by being removed; every barrier, she said, is an intention that has agreed to look like steel. He said the steel was never the argument.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 障碍物；屏障（护栏）
B. n. 屏障（指那个东西本身，与争论相对）
C. 固定搭配：put up a barrier 竖起一道屏障
D. n. 屏障（指镇上每一道）
E. n. 屏障（指学校旁那一道）
F. n. 障碍（语言上的困难）
G. n. 障碍（抽象：人与人之间那道墙）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a barrier at the end of our road
The barrier, meaning the thing itself and not the argument
barrier was the whole of the language
The barrier, meaning the thing between two people
the barrier had become a photograph in a report
The barrier of the whole thing
A barrier, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: put up a barrier 意为“竖起一道屏障”，1960 年议会在我们那条路的尽头竖起了一道屏障。
barrier 意为“屏障”，指那个东西本身而不是争论，它是九英尺钢，一周内就被人翻过去了。
barrier 指镇上每一道屏障，那个镇上每一道都是星期五竖起来的。
barrier 指学校旁那一道（有缺口的那一道），是唯一被人好好利用的。
barrier 意为“障碍”，指语言上的困难，母亲说 barrier 就是语言的全部，指的是困难而不是钢。
barrier 为抽象用法，指人与人之间那道墙，是唯一你看它时它还会长的墙。
barrier 意为“屏障、护栏”，到 1973 年这个 barrier 成了报告里的一张照片。
barrier 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，父亲五月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的钢和一个缺口。
barrier 意为“屏障”，我记得的是学校旁那一道，1975 年被拆走，再没补上。
barrier 为抽象总称，祖母说屏障是唯一会因为被拆掉而变好的构筑物。
